これまで兄を装ってきた、貼り付けたような笑みは、既に跡形もなくなっていた。

pages.en:
“You’ve taken your sweet time coming home, haven’t you!?”

“—!”

The face of the man who had once been her brother, his mask stripped away.

The pasted-on smile with which he had played the brother until now was gone without a trace.

pages.en:
“You traitor… You disgrace to the Matou family…!”

He advances, screaming.

The man fixes the girl with a vindictive glare and closes upon her, his steps slow but laden with menace.

“—!”

The girl’s chin jerks upward.

She realizes that naked hatred—an emotion approaching murderous intent—is directed at her.

そうだ、どんなに普通の人間の装っても変わらない。
おまえは間桐の女だ。卑しい魔術師くずれ、恐れ、怯え、やがて感情をなくし人形と変わらなくなる！」
男は荒々しく、更に少女へと歩を進める。
「んっ……！ だ、や
」
後ずさる。
久しく忘れていた優越感に、男は笑みを浮かべた。

pages.en:
“Ha—That’s right. That’s how you’re supposed to be!

“Yes, no matter how hard you pretend to be an ordinary person, nothing changes. You’re a woman of the Matou family. A wretched failure of a mage. You’ll fear and tremble until all your feelings die, and then you’ll be no different from a doll!”

The man advances more violently upon the girl.

“Ngh…! D-don’t—”

She retreats.

The return of a superiority he had long forgotten brings a smile to his face.

pages.ja:
だから、その瞬間まで気付かなかった。
彼の眼前で怯える少女には、今までのような従順さはない。
顔を背け、体をねじる少女の反応には、もはや嫌悪と抵抗しかない事に、男だけが気付かない。

pages.en:
And so he fails to notice, right up until that moment.

The girl trembling before him no longer possesses her former obedience.

As she turns her face away and twists her body from him, her every response expresses nothing but revulsion and resistance. The man alone fails to see it.

“What’s this? You’re awfully lively today. …I see. I see, I see. That’s wonderful!

“Emiya must be wallowing in despair by now!”

“No—stop. Don’t come any closer, Shinji…!”

With all her strength, the girl rejects the man brimming with bloodlust.

は？」

伸ばしかけた手が僅かに下がり、男は何か、奇怪なモノと対峙したように、少女を見下ろした。

pages.en:
“—What?”

The man stops.

His outstretched hand lowers slightly. He looks down at the girl as though confronted by something bizarre and alien.

pages.ja:
「なんて言った？ いま、おまえなんて言った？」
呆然とした声。
少女はごくりと喉を鳴らして、ありったけの勇気を込めて男を見つめ返す。
pages.jaRuby:
「なんて言った？ いま、おまえなんて言った？」
呆然とした声。
少女はごくりと喉を鳴らして、ありったけの勇気を込めて男を見つめ返す。
pages.en:
“What did you say? What did you just say to me?”

His voice is vacant with disbelief.

The girl swallows and, summoning every scrap of courage she possesses, meets his eyes.

pages.ja:
「
ち、近寄らないで、と言ったんです。わたしは、これ以上兄さんの言いなりにはならない。
……先輩。先輩は、こんなわたしでも受け入れてくれた。わたしを守るって言ってくれた……！ わたしは兄さんの玩具じゃない。わたしはもう……！」

“—I-I said not to come any closer. I won’t do whatever you tell me anymore.

“Shirou accepted me, even as I am. He said he would protect me…! I’m not your toy. Not anymore…!”

“—Don’t fuck with me. Don’t fuck with me, don’t fuck with me, don’t fuck with me, you—!”

—and erupts with every ounce of rage inside him.

「衛宮だと……！？ 僕の言いなりにはならない……！？
勘違いするな、何様のつもりだおまえ！ 決めるのはいつでも兄である僕だ、おまえは今まで通り、ただ黙って従えばいいんだよ……！」
堰の壊れた激流を止める手段はない。
これまで絶対に裏切らなかったものに逆らわれた男には、まともな理性など残ってはいない。

pages.en:
“Emiya…!? You won’t do what I tell you…!?

“Don’t get the wrong idea. Who the hell do you think you are!? I’m your older brother, and I’m the one who decides. You just have to shut up and obey me, exactly as you always have…!”

There is no stopping a torrent once the dam has broken.

Defied by the one thing that had never betrayed him, the man has no reason left.

男の憤怒は止まることを知らない。

“Take it back, Sakura! You’re mine. You don’t belong to anyone else…! Know your place. You’re a woman of the Matou family…! That means you have no right—none at all—to defy me…!”

The man’s fury knows no end.

“　　　　　　　　　　　”

The girl’s eyes condemn him with unyielding resolve.

自分をまっすぐに見つめてくる目がイヤだった。

笑う。
笑う。
楽しげに兄は笑う。

The look in her eyes infuriates him beyond measure.

He cannot stand those eyes staring straight into his own.

Yet at the same time, he laughs at her powerless resistance.

He laughs.

Laughs.

Her brother laughs with delight.

I understand what this person is thinking.

he means to ruin me for no other reason than his own amusement.

“——Why…?”

The word escapes me.

Why does it always come to this?

I have endured so many things for so long.

I lied. I lied to others, and I lied to myself. I kept telling myself that even someone like me could be happy.

I believed that merely being allowed to stay in Shirou’s home was happiness enough.

why can’t this person allow me even that?

“————”

…No. He isn’t the only one who never allowed it.

I have thought it for so long.

I have resented it for so long.

Why?

Why—why does the entire world around me hate me so much—?

All strength leaves me.

The will to resist disappears, and the man who is her brother looks down upon the girl with satisfaction.

“Ha—haha, hahahahahahahahahaha!”

Vacant and dazed, the girl looks up at the gloating man, at the naked blackness of his heart.

“—I wish someone like you didn’t exist.”

For the first time in eleven years, she permits herself the thought.

The girl sits up and gazes at her silent brother.

He died instantly.

Something like an impossibly sharp cord must have snapped across his head.

There is only a line upon the back of his skull, as fine as if drawn in pencil.

The line reaches into his brain, but the wound is too narrow to spill what lies within. It releases only a vivid thread of red.

“————Ah.”

She looks down at it without feeling.

The shadow that killed her brother wavers.

It wavers in the gray sunlight.

Her own shadow.

The shadow cast by her body in the light has risen, smooth and featureless, and now it sways behind her.

“————Ahh.”

Then she is the one who killed him.

She killed her brother.

The girl understands this, yet she feels nothing.

Nothing.

Nothing.

Nothing.

Neither disgust nor fear, guilt nor regret.

Only one thought enters her empty heart.

That was easy.

She has seen it countless times in her dreams.

Because she dreamed it—because she dreamed it, perhaps she only copied what she had seen…?

She doesn’t quite understand.

But if it was this easy, she should have done it much sooner.

If she was going to feel nothing, she should have done it much sooner.

So the girl thinks.

“————Heh——hehe.”

And the feelings that should have been empty whisper that it was fun.

It was fun.

Where?

They weren’t dreams.

The one who wandered the city night after night and killed the men who approached her was none other than me.

Yes. I killed so many.

So many, so many.

I did. I KILLED THEM, laughing all the while…!

だって、笑わないと壊れそうだ。
笑っていないと耐えられない。
けど笑えば笑うほどボロボロと崩れていって、涙が止まらなくて、何もかもがどうでもよくなっていく。
pages.en:
“—Aha. Ahaha. Ahahahaha.”

I laugh because it’s funny.

Because if I don’t laugh, I think I’ll break.

I can’t bear it unless I keep laughing.

But the more I laugh, the more completely I crumble. The tears will not stop, and everything matters less and less.

pages.ja:
「はは！ あはは、はははははははははははは！」
おかしくておなかが痛い。
笑えば笑うほど馬鹿になっていくみたい。
でもそれがとても楽で、とてもとても自然に映る。
ああ、なんてバカらしいバカらしい愚かな自分……！

pages.en:
“Haha! Ahaha, hahahahahahahahahaha!”

It’s so funny my stomach hurts.

The more I laugh, the more stupid I become.

And yet it feels so easy. So very, very natural.

Oh, what a ridiculous, ridiculous fool I am…!

pages.ja:
「
ふ
ふふ、あ」
ひきつった笑み。
もう動かない兄に代わって、少女は可憐に、クスクスと硝子のような声を零す。
pages.jaRuby:
「
ふ
ふふ、あ」
ひきつった笑み。
もう動かない兄に代わって、少女は可憐に、クスクスと硝子のような声を零す。
pages.en:
“—Heh—hehe, ah.”

A twisted smile.

In place of her brother, who will never move again, the girl giggles prettily, spilling laughter as brittle as glass.

pages.ja:
……そうして。
兄の体をままごとのように沢山、色々といじったあと、少女はベッドから立ち上がった。
血に濡れた姿のまま姿見の前に立つ。
その後ろには、多くの人間を殺してきた影が立っている。
pages.jaRuby:

血に濡れた姿のまま姿見の前に立つ。

pages.en:
…And then—

after playing with her brother’s body in all sorts of ways, as though she were playing house, the girl rises from the bed.

Still drenched in blood, she stands before the full-length mirror.

—Behind her stands the shadow that has killed so many people.

pages.ja:
自分の影。
もう、何十人という人間を食べてきた自分自身。
いつかそうなってしまわないように必死に自分を抑えて、
そうならないようにと傍にいてくれた誰か。
笑ってしまう。
そんなもの、初めから全部無駄だった。
pages.jaRuby:
自分の影。
もう、何十人という人間を食べてきた[ruby text=くろいかげ char=4]自分自身。
いつかそうなってしまわないように必死に自分を抑えて、
そうならないようにと傍にいてくれた誰か。
笑ってしまう。
そんなもの、初めから全部無駄だった。
pages.en:
Her own shadow.

Her own self—the black shadow that has already devoured dozens of people.

She fought desperately to restrain herself so that she would never become this.

Someone remained by her side in the hope of keeping it from happening.

She almost laughs.

All of it had been pointless from the beginning.

pages.ja:
「
なんだ。少しずつおかしくなってたんじゃないんだ」
くるり、と姿見の前で回る。
少女は誇らしげな微笑みを浮かべ、
「
見てください先輩。わたし、最初から壊れてたんです」
そう、ダンスを求めるように語りかけた。
pages.jaRuby:
「
なんだ。少しずつおかしくなってたんじゃないんだ」

pages.en:
“—Oh. So I wasn’t slowly losing my mind.”

She turns before the mirror in a little circle.

The girl smiles proudly.

“—Look, Shirou. I was broken from the very beginning.”

She speaks as though inviting him to dance.

pages.ja:
少女の意識はそこで終わった。
いや、正確に言えば代わった。
いままでフタをし続けた無意識が、ただ表層に浮かび上がっただけの話。
pages.jaRuby:

いや、正確に言えば代わった。

pages.en:
The girl’s consciousness ends there.

No—to be precise, it changes places.

The unconscious she had kept sealed away until now has merely risen to the surface.

pages.ja:
その少女に語りかけるものがある。
少女の背後。
闇は闇のまま、気配だけを現して少女を見つめる。
pages.jaRuby:
その少女に語りかけるものがある。
少女の背後。
闇は闇のまま、気配だけを現して少女を見つめる。
pages.en:
Something speaks to the girl.

Behind her.

The darkness remains darkness, revealing only its presence as it watches her.

pages.ja:
「
多くの人間を殺したな、桜」
少女は答えない。
そんな事は、もう頷くまでもない。
pages.jaRuby:
「
多くの人間を殺したな、桜」
少女は答えない。
そんな事は、もう頷くまでもない。
pages.en:
“—You have killed many people, Sakura.”

The girl does not answer.

There is no longer any need even to nod.

pages.ja:
「
おまえは、もはや人として生きられぬ」
少女は答えない。
そんな事は、もう言われるまでもない。
pages.jaRuby:
「
おまえは、もはや人として生きられぬ」
少女は答えない。
そんな事は、もう言われるまでもない。
pages.en:
“—You can no longer live as a human being.”

The girl does not answer.

There is no longer any need for him to tell her.

pages.ja:
「
さあ、その影を受け入れるがいい。おまえを止められる者はおらぬ。アインツベルンの娘を奪い、聖杯を手に入れよ。もはや、おまえにそれ以外の生きる術はない」
「
はい。仰せのままに、お爺さま」
静かに頷く。
それが楽しそうだから頷いたのか、
それともただ逃げたかっただけなのか。
少女には、もう自分の心も判らない。

少女には、もう自分の心も判らない。
pages.en:
“—Now, accept your shadow. No one remains who can stop you. Take the Einzbern girl and obtain the Holy Grail. There is no other way left for you to live.”

“—Yes. As you command, Grandfather.”

She nods quietly.

Does she agree because it sounds like fun?

Or because she simply wishes to escape?

The girl no longer understands even her own heart.

pages.ja:
ただ、受け入れた途端、あれだけ苦しかった体が嘘のように楽になった。
……這い上がってくる。
体の芯から、黒い泥が肌を塗りたくっていく。
痛みは炎になって、少女の肌を焦がしていく。
それは呪いのように。
少女の白い肌を、違うモノへと変えていく。

pages.en:
But the instant she accepts it, the body that had been in such agony becomes miraculously light.

…It crawls upward.

From the core of her body, black mud rises and paints itself across her skin.

Pain becomes flame, searing the girl’s flesh.

Like a curse,

it transforms her white skin into something else.

pages.ja:
「
ああ、これなら」
きっと、誰にも負けない。
もう誰にも邪魔されない。
断言できる。この戦いにおいて、一番強いのは自分だと。
少女は自らを脅かし続けたモノたちを想像の中で倒していく。
pages.jaRuby:
「

断言できる。この戦いにおいて、一番強いのは自分だと。
少女は自らを脅かし続けたモノたちを想像の中で倒していく。
pages.en:
“—Ah. With this…”

No one can defeat her now.

No one can stand in her way again.

She can say it with certainty: she is the strongest participant in this war.

In her imagination, the girl strikes down every person who ever threatened her.

pages.ja:
「ん
」
ぶるり、と体が震える。
そのイメージ、想像上の行為だけで歓喜に満たされる。
……その中で。
何度も何度も現れたのは、遠坂凛という名の、彼女が最も敬愛する肉親だった。

pages.en:
“Nn—”

Her body trembles.

The images—the imaginary acts alone—fill her with ecstasy.

…And among them, appearing over and over again, is the relative she reveres above all others.

Rin Tohsaka.
